name: The Kitchen
body: The anatomical lower midriff — the warm functional core where nourishment originates. Two commercial stoves, double fridge, deep freezer, butcher-block island, a communal table seating twenty-eight in twenty-eight mismatched chairs, and enough counter space to prep for the whole house or stage a flour war. Katherine and Wynter's baking supplies have colonised an entire cabinet section despite their room being in the Chaos Agent Wing; nobody has challenged this, because Katherine's cinnamon rolls could broker peace between nations. It smells like whatever Katherine decided to stress-bake at midnight.
